segments.en: So that's right.
segments.zh: 所以这是对的。

segments.en: Men's clothes usually indicate the size of your waist.
segments.zh: 男士的衣服通常表示你腰部的大小。

segments.en: So 32 is a 32 inch waist.
segments.zh: 所以 32 是一个 32 英寸的腰部。

segments.en: But women's clothes don't have those measurements.
segments.zh: 但女装没有这些尺寸。

segments.en: And I sometimes think it would be better if we did, because it's very hard.
segments.zh: 我有时认为如果我们这样做会更好，因为这非常困难。

segments.en: Some stores have size four, which is one size, but if you go to another store, it's very different.
segments.zh: 有些商店有四号，即一种尺寸，但如果你去另一家商店，情况就大不相同了。

segments.en: So you always have to try on these clothes.
segments.zh: 所以你总是要试穿这些衣服。

segments.en: But normally in America, the sizes go from zero, which is the very, very smallest to 14 or 16, which is the largest.
segments.zh: 但通常在美国，尺寸从零开始，最小到 14 或 16，这是最大的。

segments.en: Normal size for most women would be an eight, I think, an eight or a 10.
segments.zh: 我认为，大多数女性的正常尺寸是八分之一或 10。

segments.en: And now obviously this depends on the countries, because like for example, being in Asia, in China, the women are usually a little bit thinner or smaller.
segments.zh: 现在显然这取决于国家，因为例如，在亚洲，在中国，女性通常更瘦或更小。

segments.en: So it's harder, I think, for, it's harder to actually have this universal form of measurements for girls.
segments.zh: 所以，我认为，真正为女孩提供这种通用的测量形式更难。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So in the back of your pants, for example, there'll usually be some fabric and it will say the size according to different countries.
segments.zh: 例如，在你的裤子后面，通常会有一些面料，它会根据不同的国家说大小。

segments.en: So in America, size six, in China, size, I don't know, 28.
segments.zh: 所以在美国，六号，在中国，大小，我不知道，28。

segments.en: And so they'll have the different numbers.
segments.zh: 所以他们会有不同的数字。

segments.en: And UK is also a different size.
segments.zh: 而英国的规模也不同。

segments.en: Kind of like your shoes.
segments.zh: 有点像你的鞋子。

segments.en: If you look inside your shoe, it'll say, I think, a Japanese size, the UK size, which is like 41, 42, and the USA size, which is like size eight or nine.
segments.zh: 如果你看你的鞋子，我想它会说，日本尺寸，英国尺寸，41、42 和美国尺寸，大小为 8 或 9。

segments.en: So, it's very, very interesting, especially when you're buying clothes, you have to remember what size you are and you have to ask the person to, that you try it on.
segments.zh: 所以，这非常非常有趣，尤其是当你买衣服的时候，你必须记住你的尺寸，你必须要求对方，你试穿它。

segments.en: Because some things I know you can't try on, right?
segments.zh: 因为有些事情我知道你不能试穿，对吧？

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: And in some stores, you have to ask for help to take things off the racks.
segments.zh: 在一些商店，你必须寻求帮助才能把东西从货架上拿下来。

segments.en: So it can be very difficult.
segments.zh: 所以这可能非常困难。

segments.en: But normally, if you say, hey, can I try this on, the shopkeeper will help you.
segments.zh: 但通常，如果你说，嘿，我可以试穿吗，店主会帮助你的。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: Great stuff.
segments.zh: 真不错。

segments.en: And of course, if you have any questions or you want to comment on this lesson or any of our lessons, you can find us at EnglishPod.com.
segments.zh: 当然，如果您有任何问题或想对本课程或我们的任何课程发表评论，您可以在 Englishpod.com 上找到我们。

segments.en: We hope to see you all there.
segments.zh: 我们希望在那里见到你们。

segments.en: All right.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: Bye.
segments.zh: 再见。
